button.heliosphere.machine_start.tip: Press once everything is in: the recipe matching the ingredients now is chosen and made while they last, then the machine stops. Or click an entry of the recipe list on the right: only that recipe is made; the machine waits while ingredients are short and goes on when they are back, until you press ■
button.heliosphere.machine_stop.tip: Stop and forget the chosen recipe (progress is lost, nothing is used up)
message.heliosphere.machine_started: Started: making what the ingredients match
message.heliosphere.machine_chosen: Recipe chosen: %s (starts when the ingredients are in; ■ to cancel)
